extraction.project_name: Selection of Implementation Agency for Digital Citizen Services and Beneficiary Management System (ONE Meghalaya)
extraction.summary: The requirement document is a request for proposals for a unified digital services platform for the citizens of Meghalaya, reached through a web portal, a citizen mobile app, a WhatsApp and web chatbot, and an app for village facilitators that also works offline. Officers resolve service requests through a low-code workflow back end, and a Beneficiary Management System builds one master record and family ID for every citizen from existing state databases. It also asks for dashboards and analytics, security services, a phased rollout of services and two years of on-site support.
